_comment: English voice-over cues for Videos/pinlog_demo_concat.mp4 (30.1 s). `at` = seconds from the start of the video. `scene` describes what is on screen so a line can be rewritten without re-watching.

cues.scene: Cathedral of Learning photo dissolves into a watercolor notebook page
cues.text: Every trip starts as a blur of photos. Pinlog turns them into a story.

cues.scene: Phipps Conservatory glasshouse, inside and out; then the Warhol Museum gallery
cues.text: Drop in your day in Pittsburgh: the Cathedral of Learning, the glasshouse at Phipps, an afternoon with Warhol.

cues.scene: Gallery photo is painted over into a hand-drawn journal page with a camera and lavender
cues.text: It paints them into a hand-drawn travel journal, pinned to your map.

cues.scene: CMU campus from above, then Spring Carnival: Ferris wheel, booths, a student sketching on a red wall
cues.text: Back on campus for Carnival: the Ferris wheel, the booths, a quick sketch on the wall.

cues.scene: Kennywood wooden roller coaster under storm clouds, watercolor edges
cues.text: Then a stormy ride at Kennywood.

cues.scene: The finished journal, closed on a wooden table
